name: ci-status
description: Shows the GitHub CI state of the current branch's HEAD, and of the PRs this session opened, in a band above the prompt. Hidden whenever GitHub cannot be read.

pollSeconds.title: Poll interval while checks run (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often to read GitHub while any check is pending.

idlePollMinutes.title: Poll interval while nothing runs (minutes)
idlePollMinutes.description: How often to read GitHub while no check is pending. 0 reads only at session start, after a push and after a PR is opened.

maxFailingNames.title: Failing checks named
maxFailingNames.description: How many failing check names the band lists.
